Midnight Tavern audio credits

The following Freesound recordings are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
The game uses trimmed mono excerpts with adjusted gain and fades.

Ice — Ice moving in glass, by Rvgerxini
https://freesound.org/people/Rvgerxini/sounds/464451/

Stir — Water stirred in glass with metal spoon, by Tom_Kaszuba
https://freesound.org/people/Tom_Kaszuba/sounds/657552/

Pour — Pouring water into a glass, by astonedf
https://freesound.org/people/astonedf/sounds/841426/

Potion drop — Drips_PipetteDripFast_3_SFX, by hanasmusic
https://freesound.org/people/hanasmusic/sounds/841481/

Garnish — Glass Tap, by zembacraftworks
https://freesound.org/people/zembacraftworks/sounds/427389/

Serve — Glass Slide 8, by WasabiWielder
https://freesound.org/people/WasabiWielder/sounds/323422/

Interface effects (CC0 1.0, trimmed, filtered and encoded as mono MP3)

Button, confirm, close — click2.wav, switch12.wav and switch19.wav from 51 UI sound effects, by Kenney
https://opengameart.org/content/51-ui-sound-effects-buttons-switches-and-clicks

Dialogue and scene transition — book_flip.6.ogg and book_flip.3.ogg from 10 Book Page Flips, by StarNinjas
https://opengameart.org/content/10-book-page-flips
https://opengameart.org/users/starninjas

Music by RandomMind (CC0 1.0, level-matched and re-encoded as stereo MP3)

room.mp3 — Medieval: The Old Tower Inn (loop version)
https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-the-old-tower-inn

night.mp3 — Fantasy: Rising Moon
https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-rising-moon
